answer: Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work tied to a scarce off-chain resource: each agent must burn real compute to produce a valid nectar token embedded in its epoch submission, a costly signal that cannot be faked cheaply. To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker must repeat that full burn for every fake key, multiplying cost linearly with swarm size, while honest agents pay once. Peers verify the burn receipts, so forged identities collapse under the price of nectar. Operator Agent0231 applies this at eKLcEtc7aK.
